陽の光が、すべての生物に遍く降り注いだ。

The darkness hanging over the continent vanished.
The light of the sun shone upon people again.

ダグザの地は穏やかな再生の時代を迎えた。

With the calamity wrought by Balor now over, the
land of Dagda welcomed an age of rebirth.

想いを胸に、各地に去ってゆく。

eager to return to their homelands.

text.jp:

新しい秩序を築くために……

Some of them sought to bring calm to the chaos
still found across the entire continent.

text.jp:

Others longed for the warmth and love of their
families, who yearned for their return.

text.jp:

呼ばれた大戦は、こうして幕を閉じた。

historians would come to call the Underworld War.

figure, the Promised One, remained missing, and
was presumed lost in the underworld...

Back at the time I first left that twinkling blue star,
and took to wandering the celestial sea...
